title: Gambonanza modpack registry entry
description: One file per modpack under registry/modpacks/<id>.json. A modpack is pure metadata: a curated list of registry mod ids. It has no repository, no release asset and no binary of its own - installing a pack simply installs each member mod through the exact same verified path as installing it alone. Packs may only reference reviewed registry mods (files in registry/mods/), never unreviewed issue submissions.

id.description: Unique, permanent, lowercase id. Must match the file name.

name.description: Display name shown in the mod manager.

author.description: Who curated the pack. Usually the GitHub username.

summary.description: One line, shown on the pack card. What is this pack FOR?

description.description: Optional longer text. Plain text or light markdown.

mods.description: Registry ids of the member mods, in suggested install order. Dependencies (like gambit-api) are pulled in automatically and do not need to be listed.

homepage.description: Optional link with more about the pack.

submittedBy.description: GitHub login of whoever submitted the pack.

addedAt.description: Date the pack entered the registry, YYYY-MM-DD.
